slots.sentence: Figure 2 also marks the date August 19, 2026, when the U.S. Treasury made its surprise buyback announcement of longer-term debt, which was the peak in the sell-off of longer-maturity Treasury bonds, which coincided with markets worrying about Fed credibility in the wake of the July 29 meeting.
